label: Ervin House · 2026 congressional district evidence
scope: 435 districts on current 2026 congressional map geometry where changed; 433 numeric two-party congressional scenarios, and two ballot-specific Cook qualitative ratings (AK-01, CA-06). Reconstructed presidential vote allocations in 173 redrawn seats carry extra uncertainty.

method.formula: House margin D−R = dated generic House polling + 2018/2022 past-only selected alpha × [0.75 × (2024 congressional-district presidential D−R less national 2024 D−R) + 0.25 × (2020 district presidential D−R less national 2020 D−R)], blended only with candidate-compatible House district polls; checked on 2024 House holdout. Never uses old-map House results as new-map voting.

inputs.status: secondary compilation, not independently verified current DDHQ publisher output
verified Silver Bulletin average, not likely-voter adjusted 9.2

genericBallot.note: Dated Nov 2 publisher-specific snapshot, not a claim of Nov 3 refresh. DDHQ input is secondary.

historicalReturns.source: MIT Election Data and Science Lab 1976–2024, public domain via electiondata.dev

polling.source: The New York Times CC BY 4.0 polling index as summarized at PeoplesPoll; original linked releases; RCP latest polls
polling.note: Archive shows only subset of all published surveys; a published survey count is not the number of rows displayed.

method.specialCaveat: Alaska ranked-choice and California independent top-two ballots are not modeled as two-party D−R matchups; Cook qualitative source ratings only.
method.uncertainty: Sensitivity only: historical 2024 holdout MAE applies to contested same-map districts, NOT a calibrated 2026 confidence interval. An added width accounts for reconstructed 2026 district voting allocations.

presidentialCurrentMap.source: Scorvec midterms-2026 district lean static dataset; derived from MIT Election Data and Science Lab precinct vote returns, VEST 2020 precinct election results, 2020 Census blocks, 120th congressional district equivalency, state totals and county-based swing. Model-derived allocations are approximate (particularly in redrawn districts).
presidentialCurrentMap.notes: District-level reallocated 2024 and 2020 presidential election votes and two-party D−R margins. Map-verified=false for all 173 2026 redrawn seats; estimates rely on split precinct/block and county/cell swing assumptions. These are historical reconstructed returns, never recorded votes in 2026. Missouri remains the pre-redraw 2022/2024 2026 ballot plan.
